verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              चतुर्युगादिसम्भूतौ सहस्रयुगपर्यये। विघ्नस्तमासि सम्भूतो मधुर्नाम महासुरः॥१॥
verses.bhavadeepa: विभुरिति। तथैव परमस्तथैव शयने स्थूलदेहविस्मरणे पद्मानां निधिम् अनन्तानि पद्मानीत्यर्थः। महार्णवे परमात्मनि॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: तस्यैव च सहायोऽन्यो भूतो रजसि कैटभः। तौ रजस्तमसाविष्टौ सम्भूतौ कामरूपिणौ॥२॥
verses.english: With reverence and compassion satyavrata pledged to look after the wife and family of vishvAmitra, for which he had been hunting harts, boars, buffalos, and other forest ranging animals, and used to hang up the meat on trees near at a place where vishvAmitra is undertaking ascesis for the sake of that family.
verses.bhavadeepa: सप्तमे लयविक्षेपौ विघ्नौ तामसराजसौ। सत्त्वेन विष्णुना क्षेप्यौ मधुकैटभरूपकौ॥ चतुर्युगादिः कृतं सात्त्विको योगधर्मः तत्रापि सम्भूतौ अधर्मपादस्य सत्तवोक्तेः सहस्रयुगपर्यये अमिताविद्यारात्रिक्षयसमये चित्तसत्त्वं हि तत्त्वे प्रणिधीयमानं दैनन्दिनलयाभ्यासात्तमसः प्राबल्ये सति लीयते स लयोऽत्र मधुनामा॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: एकार्णवजलं सर्वं क्षोभयन्ती महासुरौ। कृष्णरक्ताम्बरधरौ श्वेत दीप्तोग्रदंष्ट्रिणौ॥३॥
verses.english: satyavrata spent twelve years of his exile without others noticing his pledges according to the orders of his father.
verses.bhavadeepa: तथा रजःप्राबल्ये सति क्षणिकसत्तवोत्कर्षात्सत्यपि क्षणं तत्त्वलाभे पुनः संसारप्रवणं भवति स विक्षेपो नाम विघ्नोऽत्र कैटभो नाम। योऽयं सत्त्वाविविक्तश्चिद्धातुः स जीवो ब्रह्मा नाम। तस्य हिंसां संसारसङ्कटे पातनं विष्णुः सत्त्वं तच्छरीरे सत्त्वे एव तयोर्नाशः अग्रिमकल्पेऽप्युत्थानं तत्र मधुकैटभयोः विष्णुपुत्रत्वं रजस्तमसोः सत्त्वं प्रत्युपसर्जनत्वम्॥२॥

verses.sanskrit: उभौ मदकटोदग्रौ केयूरवलयोज्ज्वलौ। महाविकृतताम्राक्षौ पीनोरस्कौ महाभुजौ॥४॥
verses.english: When the king trayyaruNa also went to woods in search of his son, then sage vashiSTha safeguarded the kingdom, ayodhya and palace-chambers of queens, as he is that kingdom's royal priest, teacher and as the wheelsman of vedic rituals for that family.

verses.sanskrit: महच्छिरःसंहननौ जङ्गमाविव पर्वतौ। नीलमेघाभ्रसङ्काशावादित्यप्रतिमाननौ॥५॥
verses.english: When the scare of famine ended after twelve years, vishvAmitra established satyavrata on the throne of ayodhya and conducted vedic rituals for him.

verses.sanskrit: विद्युदम्भोदताम्राभ्यां कराभ्यामतिभीषणौ। पादसञ्चारवेगाभ्यामुत्क्षिपन्ताविवार्णवम्॥६॥
verses.english: "Technically any bride and bridegroom will not be declared married unless the seventh joint-circumambulation around ritual fire is finished with chanting of hymns like - सखा सप्त-पडी मम... Till such time the bride remains a damsel. Though this rule position is known to him, and though I carried off an unwed damsel, vashiSTha countenanced the unnecessary fury of my father when my father declared me a wife-lifter..." this is the grouse nurtured by satyavrata against vashiSTha.

verses.sanskrit: कम्पयन्ताविव हरिं शयानमरिसूदनम्। तौ तत्र विहरन्तौ स्म पुष्करे विश्वतोमुखम्॥७॥
verses.english: Whatever that godly vashiSTha did is with certain foreseeing, but satyavrata is not cognisant of that sage's thinking.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तावूचतुस्तत्र ब्रह्माणमसुरोत्तमौ। दृप्तौ युयुत्सुकौ क्रुद्धौ रोषसंरक्तलोचनौ॥९॥
verses.english: When the father of satyavrata too is unhappy about the exile and proceeded in search of his son, then indra did not cause rains for twelve long years.

verses.sanskrit: पश्यतां दीप्तवपुषं योगिनां श्रेष्ठमुत्तमम्। नारायणसमाज्ञप्तं सृजन्तमखिलाः प्रजाः। दैवतानि च विश्वानि मानसांश्च सुतानृषीन्॥१०॥
verses.english: "You cruel fellow... two sins carried on your head are not enough or what... you committed this third sin also... now I should quash you down, undoubtedly...

verses.sanskrit: कस्त्वं पुरुष मध्यस्थः सितोष्णीषश्चतुर्मुखः। आवामगणयन्मोहादासे त्वं विगतज्वरः॥१०॥
verses.english: "You cruel fellow... two sins carried on your head are not enough or what... you committed this third sin also... now I should quash you down, undoubtedly...

verses.sanskrit: एह्यावयोर्बाहुयुद्धं प्रयच्छ कमलोद्भव। आवाभ्यामतिवीराभ्यां न शक्यं स्थातुमाहवे॥११॥
verses.english: "You transgressed in three ways... you hurt the feelings of your father in two ways - by using an unsanctified food earmarked for manes, and by abducting an bride; now, by killing a sacred cow of your own family priest..." vashiSTha cursed satyavrata in this way.

verses.sanskrit: कस्त्वं कश्चोद्भवस्तुभ्यं केन वासीह चोदितः। कः स्रष्टा कश्च वै गोप्ता केन नाम्नाभिधीयसे॥१२॥
verses.english: He no only partook in that cow meat, but fed the children of vishvAmitra with it. vashiSTha's rage is heightened and he cursed satyavrata in this way.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मोवाच।
              यः क इत्युच्यते लोके ह्यविज्ञातः सहस्रशः। तत्सम्भवं योगवन्तं किं मां नाभ्यवगच्छथः॥१४॥
verses.english: But, oh, king janamejaya, once when the hunt is unavailable, satyavrata killed the cow of vashiSTha, which is a sacred cow yielding all desired objects. He did so because he is ensorcelled by ten-subversions because he is famished.

verses.sanskrit:
मधुकैटभावूचतुः।
              नावयोः परमं लोके किञ्चिदस्ति महामते। आवां छादयता विश्वं तमसा रजसा तथा॥१४॥
verses.english: But, oh, king janamejaya, once when the hunt is unavailable, satyavrata killed the cow of vashiSTha, which is a sacred cow yielding all desired objects. He did so because he is ensorcelled by ten-subversions because he is famished.

verses.sanskrit: रजस्तममोमयावावां यतीनां दुःखलक्षणौ। छलकौ धर्मशीलानां दुस्तरौ सर्वदेहिनाम्॥१५॥
verses.english: Because satyavrata committed three offences, vashiSTha labelled him as त्रि-शन्कु... as such he is generally identified with the name त्रि-शन्कु॥।

verses.sanskrit: आवाभ्यां मुह्यते लोक उच्छ्रिताभ्यां युगे युगे। आवामर्थश्च कामश्च यज्ञाः सर्वपरिग्रहाः॥१६॥
verses.english: He no only partook in that cow meat, but fed the children of vishvAmitra with it. vashiSTha's rage is heightened and he cursed satyavrata in this way.

verses.sanskrit: सुखं यत्र मुदो यत्र यत्र श्रीः सन्निवृत्तयः। एषां यत्काङ्क्षितं चैव तत्तदावां विचिन्तय॥१७॥
verses.english: When the scare of famine ended after twelve years, vishvAmitra established satyavrata on the throne of ayodhya and conducted vedic rituals for him.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मोवाच।
              यत्तद्योगवतां श्रेष्ठं यच्च सर्वं मयार्चितम्। तत्समाधाय गुणवान्त्सत्त्वजोऽस्मि प्रतिष्ठितः॥१८॥
verses.english: To the reluctance of gods, as well as that of vashiSTha, vishvAmitra strived to send satyavrata to heaven with his mortal body.

verses.sanskrit: यत्परं योगयुक्तानामक्षरं सत्त्वमेव च। रजसस्तमसश्चैव यत्स्रष्टा जीवसम्भवः॥१९॥
verses.english: Because satyavrata committed three offences, vashiSTha labelled him as त्रि-शन्कु... as such he is generally identified with the name त्रि-शन्कु॥।

verses.sanskrit: यतो भूतानि जायन्ते सात्त्विकानीतराणि च। स एवं युक्तः समरे वशी वां शमयिष्यति॥२०॥
verses.english: And, trishanku's son rAjA harishchandra is a well-known entity... he successfully performed rAjasUya-yAga, and acquired the title of emperor...

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततः शयानं श्रीमन्तं बहुयोजनविस्तृतम्। पद्मनाभं हृषीकेशं प्रणम्योवाच तावुभौ॥२१॥
verses.english: harishchandra's son is a valiant one named रोहित, or लोहित, by whom the city रोहित-पुरम् is built for the purpose of his administration... having ruled the kingdom well keeping the interests of subjects in view, this रोहित has become a kingly-saint left off that city to brahmaNA-s, as he realised that the world is pithless...

verses.sanskrit: जानीवस्त्वां विश्वयोनिमेकं पुरुषसत्तमम्। तवोपासनहेत्वर्थमिदं नौ विद्धि कारणम्॥२२॥
verses.english: रोहित's son is हरित; from him forward the princes are; हरित चेन्चु got two sons namely विजय and सुदेव, out of them prince vijaya became famous because he vanquished all kshatriya-s of his age...

verses.sanskrit: अमोघदर्शनं सत्यं यतस्त्वां विदुरीश्वरम्। ततस्त्वामभितो देव काङ्क्षावः प्रतिवीक्षितुम्॥२३॥
verses.english: To the reluctance of gods, as well as that of vashiSTha, vishvAmitra strived to send satyavrata to heaven with his mortal body.

verses.sanskrit: तदिच्छावो वरं दत्तं त्वया ह्यावामरिन्दम। अमोघं दर्शनं देव नमस्तेऽस्त्वजितञ्जय॥२४॥
verses.english: satyavrata's wife is lady सत्य-रथ, a descendant of केकय lineage, and she begot the impeccable king harishchandra.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच।
              कानिच्छतो द्रुतं ब्रूतं वरानसुरसत्तमौ। दत्तायुषौ मया भूयस्त्वहो जीवितुमिच्छथः॥२५॥
verses.english: And, trishanku's son rAjA harishchandra is a well-known entity... he successfully performed rAjasUya-yAga, and acquired the title of emperor...

verses.sanskrit: तस्माद्यदेष वां यत्नस्तत्प्राप्नुतं महाबलौ। वध्यौ भवन्तौ तु स्यातां तावित्येवाब्रवीद्धरिः। उभावपि महात्मानावूरतौ क्षतवर्जितौ॥२६॥

मधुकैटभावूचतुः।
              यस्मिन्नकश्चिन्मृतवांस्तस्मिन्देशे विभो वधम्। इच्छावः पुत्रतां यातुं तव चैव सुराधिप॥२७॥

श्रीभगवानुवाच।
              बाढं सुतौ मे प्रवरौ भविष्ये कल्पसम्भवे। भविष्यथो न सन्देहः सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमि वाम्॥२८॥

वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              वरं प्रदायाथ महासुराभ्यां सनातनो विश्ववरोत्तमो विभुः। रजस्तमोभ्यां भवभावनोपमौ ममन्थ तावूरुतले सुरारिहा॥२९॥
